basic_info.description: Views Above All in One Rincon Hill's North East Corner with the sought-after 07 Floor Plan. This remarkable one-bedroom, one-bathroom residence features a glass-enclosed balcony that offers stunning panoramic views of the Downtown skyline and Bay Bridge, framed by oversized insulated glass windows. The kitchen is designed for culinary enthusiasts, showcasing Italian Del Tongo cabinetry, polished granite countertops, a high-end Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Bosch stainless steel appliances. The bathroom exudes elegance with granite counters and modern finishes. Additional features include hardwood floors, custom lighting, a spacious walk-in closet, and an in-unit Bosch washer/dryer. Immerse yourself in a vibrant community, with tech giants like Google Spear St, Facebook, and LinkedIn SF offices, along with the Transbay Terminal and SF MOMA, all just 6-10 minutes away by foot.  Residents benefit from exclusive amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, concierge services, valet parking, two fitness centers, and access to Uncle Harry's Penthouse Lounge.
